title: Always
lyrics:
[00:21.46]This Romeo is bleedin'
[00:24.79]But you can't see his blood
[00:28.41]It's nothing but some feelings
[00:30.52]That this old dog kicked up
[00:34.96]It's been rainin' since you left me
[00:37.51]Now I'm drownin' in the flood
[00:41.63]You see I've always been a fighter
[00:44.16]But without you, I give up
[00:48.96]I can't sing a love song, like the way it's meant to be
[00:54.55]Well, I guess I'm not that good anymore, but baby, that's just me
[01:01.25]Yeah, I will love you, baby
[01:12.10]Always
[01:14.83]And I'll be there forever and a day
[01:25.74]Always
[01:29.19]I'll be there till the stars don't shine
[01:32.21]Till the heavens burst and the words don't rhyme
[01:35.54]I know when I die, you'll be on my mind
[01:38.99]And I'll love you
[01:41.05]Always
[01:49.19]Now your pictures there
[01:51.12]You left behind, all just memories of a different life
[01:55.95]Some of them made us laugh, some of them made us cry
[01:59.40]One that made you have to say goodbye
[02:02.80]What I'd give to run my fingers through your hair
[02:06.83]Touch your lips, to hold you near
[02:09.50]When you say your prayers, try to understand
[02:13.00]I've made mistakes, I'm just a man
[02:16.35]When he holds you close, when he pulls you near
[02:19.63]When he says the words, you've been needing to hear
[02:22.66]I wish I was him, but those words are mine
[02:26.41]To say to you till the end of time
[02:29.79]And I will love you, baby
[02:40.16]Always
[02:42.76]And I'll be there forever and a day
[02:53.59]Always
[02:57.69]If you told me to cry for you, I could
[03:04.44]If you told me to die for you, I would
[03:10.94]Take a look at my face, there's no price I won't pay
[03:19.84]To say these words to you
[03:49.58]Well, there ain't no luck in these loaded dice
[03:53.24]But, baby, if you give me just one more try
[03:56.34]We can pack up our old dreams and our old lives
[03:59.68]We'll find a place where the sun still shines
[04:02.87]Yeah, I will love you, baby
[04:13.39]Always
[04:15.91]And I'll be there forever and a day
[04:26.74]Always
[04:30.14]I'll be there till the stars don't shine
[04:33.10]Till the heaven's burst and the words don't rhyme
[04:36.60]I know when I die, you'll be on my mind
[04:39.81]And I'll love you
[04:41.96]Always
[04:49.20]Always
[04:54.91]Oh baby, what you doin' away? Baby, what you doin' away?
[05:01.75]Oh baby, what you doin' away, yeah, yeah
[05:09.93]Come on
[05:16.68]Away, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
[05:29.79]Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
